plan.notes: Source: 'Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog', ASE Middle School Education, SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog (PDF lines ~7751-7807). Catalog prints 'Total hours required for major - 60-61'; the plan sequences four 3-credit content courses (12 hours), so sequenced sum = 61 (upper end of the printed 60-61 range). Footnote 1: students selecting a math or science concentration are recommended to take MATH 1023 and PHYS 2003/2001 for general education physical science; MATH 1053 recommended for language arts/social studies concentrations. 'Content Course' slots are filled from the declared middle school content concentration area.
